product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI offers an agentic AI work platform and super assistant that combines frontier models, autonomous agents, and organizational memory to automate work for professionals, small teams, and enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing plans.

named_customers.notes: Both are named on the company's case-studies page.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn lists 287 official employees, which falls in this band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog has technical posts on LLM training and context-length research. Arka Pal is identified as an Abacus AI researcher, and both Pal and Deep Karkhanis appear as authors on Abacus.AI research publications.

public_docs.notes: The help center links to multiple product how-to guides and documentation topics.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists a Research Scientist role focused on generative AI and LLMs.

model_provider.value: Multiple providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, and Qwen; RouteLLM selects among models.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names these as badges or standards; PCI DSS is not listed there.

last_funding.notes: A February 12, 2026 announcement reports $50 million in additional funding but does not specify a formal stage. Tracxn still lists the October 2021 Series C as its latest recorded round, so the 2026 announcement is reported with medium confidence.

raised_18mo.notes: The February 12, 2026 funding announcement falls within the 18-month window before November 9, 2026; Tracxn's profile has not recorded that round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists a Junior Sales Development Representative (Jr SDR) role.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 21, 2026, Abacus AI announced the release of its free, open-source Abacus AI Bot.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jason Dugas's profile lists him as Regional Vice President, Enterprise Sales at Abacus.AI, with a start date of 2026-07-01.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Outreach and Salesloft are named as outbound-prospecting tools in a job post. Salesforce appears in product connector documentation, indicating an integration rather than confirming internal CRM adoption.
